assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The procedure is intended to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The clinical indication includes dizziness, coded as R42.
The denial was based on reason code CO-197.
